headline: Capacity for the life you actually have.
metaDescription: Why TAB Human Performance Center exists and how we help people build capacity for real life.

sections.title: Why TAB exists
paragraphs: TAB Human Performance Center, formerly TAB Massage & Fitness, exists to help people build greater capacity for real life: the strength, resilience, adaptability, agency, vitality, connection and self-trust to meet life as it is, recover from what it asks, and act on what matters.
Human performance at TAB isn’t maximum output or a version of you that never gets tired. It’s how well the whole person functions, adapts, recovers, connects and acts under real-life conditions.

sections.title: Start where you are
paragraphs: You don’t need to arrive with everything figured out. You may know exactly what you need, or simply that something needs to change.
Wherever you’re starting, we begin by listening—to understand what matters to you, what your life actually looks like, and what meaningful progress would feel like from your perspective.

sections.title: Transform. Adapt. Balance.
paragraphs: TAB stands for Transform. Adapt. Balance. It’s more than our name; it’s how we work. Transform what limits you. Adapt to what life asks. Balance what sustains you.
The process has direction, but there isn’t a finish line.

sections.title: Built around people, not programs
paragraphs: Every person comes to TAB with a different body, history, lifestyle, set of responsibilities, and goals. Our role isn’t to fit you into a predefined program; it’s to help you understand what works for you.
That may mean one TAB service or several over time. When connections make sense, we help bring the pieces together. When they don’t, we don’t force them.

sections.title: Support that builds ownership
paragraphs: Success at TAB isn’t measured by how dependent you become on us. Sometimes that means continuing regular support; sometimes it means maintenance, independence, or knowing TAB is here when your needs change again.
